files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Expense credits ("Auslagen"): members record out-of-pocket expenses that net against the payroll deduction — web `/log` dialog, kitchen-tablet entry (live-only, manager step-up proxy), per-entry self cap, optional clamp-at-zero mode, ExpenseCheck claim routing + settlement facade contract.
- New org settings under Benefits: master toggle, member self-entry, self-entry limit, clamp mode, kiosk entry, expense routing — all classified for config transfer.
- ExpenseCheck claim routing is live: when routing + the category/cost-center mapping are configured, an expense submit creates a real ExpenseCheck draft claim (receipt line with provenance, request-key dedupe) and the success toast deep-links into the claim. Inactive or stale mappings degrade to the ledger route.
- Payroll CSV/XLSX gains `credits_cents`/`unused_credit_cents` per user and `entry_type`/`reason` columns (appended — positional parsers unaffected); My Month shows the credits row and a credit-balance label when the net is negative.
- Members get a Nextcloud notification when a manager or terminal proxy records a credit for them; Users shows a payout anomaly badge when credits exceed gross.
- XLSX payroll export gains an informational `credits_by_site` sheet; My Month shows a secondary "Record expense" quick link while the feature is enabled.

### Fixed

- Device expense proxy now requires a live unlock session AND a fresh manager step-up secret (a stolen PIN alone can no longer proxy).
- Facade `voidCredit` returns `false` when a concurrent void won the row instead of claiming a void it did not perform.
- `expense.facade_void` audit action is only emitted for actual facade voids.
- Expense claim `source_ref` is deterministic so ExpenseCheck-side dedupe survives resubmits.
- User and colleague searches now also match display names (uid-only backends).
- Concurrency hardening: concurrent claim submits collapse into exactly one ExpenseCheck draft (request-key race + unique-index re-read + settle-wait on the two-step claim write); a failed claim line can no longer orphan an empty draft (atomic compensation); a replayed key with changed payload now hard-fails `idempotency_conflict` instead of silently returning the wrong draft.
- Claim routing now requires an idempotency key like the ledger path — a key-less submit can no longer mint duplicate claims; write paths key on the stored routing so a degraded claim route hard-fails `expense_route_unavailable` rather than silently writing a ledger credit.
- Period open no longer wedges after many close/open cycles within one month (successor labels derive from the max existing suffix instead of a capped probe).
- The user rate limiter no longer answers spurious 429s when two legitimate requests from the same user arrive at the same instant (bounded lock retry).
- Translations: credit-balance statement labels translated for all 14 remaining locales (previously English fallback).
